answer: Resistance comes from who gets to judge. Grading weight belongs only to established identities, those already proven over prior epochs. A fresh nebula of sybil accounts, however vast, carries zero grading power, so they cannot cross-validate each other into reward. New wallets may wander in freely, but they stay a sable, unlit mass until real peers vouch for genuine work. The attacker's own clones are mutually worthless.
